| Stage | Level | Default |
|---|---:|---|
| `prototype` | **4** | Full vibe coding; keep it isolated from real data and infrastructure |
| `proof-of-concept` | **3** | Selective review; demo paths must work reliably |
| `mvp` | **3** | Selective review plus tests; escalate sensitive paths to 2 |
| `production` | **2** | Line-by-line review of AI-generated changes |
| `critical` | **1** | AI may suggest, but engineers write or fully rewrite every line |

The core rule: code can move up a stage, but its review standard cannot stay behind.
